text:
Sasha: FYI seeing a ~3x p95 latency jump for the v4.2 rollout on a subset of hosts since 09:05 UTC. Affected route: /v1/generate, mostly short prompts but long tail seqs. Suspect batching/kernel route.
Arjun: noticing same, flamegraphs point to a spike in attention kernel time on a few GPUs. pattern looks correlated with tenant C traffic.
Maria: can you paste the perf-bot snapshot? any KV cache miss rate change?
perf-bot: snapshot uploaded: /artifacts/perf/1815001234/host-42-nvprof.json. KV cache hit-rate: 71% -> 48% after rollout on host-42. Batching window avg increased 42ms -> 120ms for the route.
Devon: that KV hit drop is interesting. v4.2 tokenizer change added new special tokens so prefix normalization increased token counts for some requests. seq len distribution shifted: median +1, 95th +14.
Sasha: exact logs: "seq_len_hist: [1..8]={...}, 95p: 176 -> 190". Kernel selector picks kernel-A for <=180, kernel-B for >180. Rollout pushed more requests into kernel-B path which is ~2.5x worse on these hosts.
Arjun: but why only on some hosts? Same runtime version. Host-42 & host-47 show much worse kernel-B perf. Could be kernel build differences or driver/kernel combo.
Maria: checked container images: identical. NVIDIA driver on host-42 is 525.85 vs 525.78 elsewhere. That can change cuBLAS/cublasLt perf.
Devon: also saw increased batching heuristic "confidence" leading to larger batch sizes because many requests had similar seq lengths after tokenizer change. Batching that hits kernel-B scales poorly when noisy neighbor C saturates memory bandwidth.
Sasha: so hypothesis: tokenizer change -> seq-length tail shift -> kernel selector flips to kernel-B -> kernel-B suffers on some hosts due to driver/hw & noisy neighbor memory pressure -> KV cache churn from more longer contexts -> per-token latency spike.
Arjun: actionable: 1) pause v4.2 rollout for affected shard, 2) temporary pin kernel selector to prefer kernel-A up to 200 tokens, 3) add soft throttle for tenant C, 4) investigate driver mismatch.
Sasha: I paused rollout for shard-3 at 09:18 UTC (deploy-bot: rollback v4.2 shard-3). Observed p95 back to baseline within 2 minutes on hosts that were reverted.
deploy-bot: rollback executed: shard-3 -> v4.1 at 2026-03-18T09:18:40Z. Canary health: degraded -> recovered.
Maria: I pushed a kernel-selector patch to gate selection on per-host perf-profile (fallback to kernel-A if host_hist shows kernel-B slower than host-median). PR: https://git.internal/r/eng/runtime/patch/236
Devon: also adding KV cache instrumentation to track per-tenant prefix eviction rate and a short-lived metric: kvcache_eviction_rate/tenant (will alert at >0.2)
Sasha: longer term: update rollout checklist to include seq-length distribution delta check and driver matrix validation. Also file a ticket to repro kernel-B perf on host-42 with nvprof + microbench.
Arjun: I'm coordinating infra to schedule driver 525.85 -> 525.78 rollback test on host-42, and a stress test with noisy-tenant patterns.
Maria: note for ops: if rolling updates change tokenizer or vocab, we should run a simulated traffic pass to estimate seq-len tail shift (script: tools/simulate_seq_shift.py --model v4.2)
Devon: temporary mitigation deployed: selector patch + tenant soft throttle + paused rollout. Metrics show p95 down from ~420ms to ~140ms on affected hosts.
Sasha: thanks everyone. Next steps assigned: Arjun (driver repro), Maria (selector PR + tests), Devon (KV metrics + alert), Sasha (rollout checklist update). Will follow up in #eng-runtime-sync tomorrow.
Arjun: tagging @infra on the driver matrix change suggestion.
Maria: adding a short blameless postmortem doc in /docs/incidents/1815001234-tokenizer-seqlen-kernel.json
Sasha: closing thread here, will open postmortem link when available. :thumbsup:
